facts.raw_span: unremitting fever with peak temperature over 40°C
simultaneous headache for 6 days
cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy with maximum diameter of 15mm
No meningeal irritation signs were detected
seizures and lost consciousness
Antinuclear antibodies were positive at 1:100 with speckled pattern
Extractable nuclear antibodies, antiphospholipid antibodies, antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies were all negative
Bone marrow smear and tissue showed trilineage hematopoiesis with histiocytes and hemophagocytosis
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed: Nucleated cells count: 454 (0-5) ×106/L, with 75% mononuclear cells
Leptomeninges thickening and enhancement observed in contrast-enhanced T1 weighted image
Groups of apoptotic bodies, abundant pink cytoplasmic fragments and small blue dots of fragmented nuclei in confluent necroptosis area
Markedly expanded paracortex (CD3+ T cells), limited CD20+ B cells in residual reactive follicles, positive CD68 and myeloperoxidase in histiocytes
